arStrings.szText:
Grants curated legendary items and a tempering manual from an archetype of your class.

{icon:bullet} Barbarian - Wastelander
{icon:bullet} Rogue - Trapper
{icon:bullet} Druid - Werewolf
{icon:bullet} Sorcerer - Pyromancy
{icon:bullet} Necromancer - Bone
{icon:bullet} Spiritborn - Gorilla
{icon:bullet} Paladin - Zealot
The path to Hell will be paved with the blood of demons. How they are to be slaughtered is yet to be written.
